item.title: Court Sentences Teacher for Sexual Harassment of Student
item.description: A court in Thessaloniki has sentenced a 56-year-old teacher to three years in prison, suspended for three years, for the sexual harassment of a young student. The Single-Member Misdemeanor Court found the educator guilty of abusing a minor and insulting sexual dignity. The legal process began in March 2023 following a formal police complaint.
